# claude-mods

> Mods for Claude Code (function-hook plugins) from the marketplace Guhan-SenSam/claude-mods: thinking-weather (a pixel-art background that reacts to the session, the context, the clock, the seasons and real weather), system-monitor (pixel CPU/RAM/GPU meters above the prompt), turn-receipt (a receipt under each reply) and pins (a pane of pinned replies). Each installs alone with `claude plugin install <mod> --marketplace Guhan-SenSam/claude-mods --scope user`.

Visual parts draw in the Claude Code desktop app; the terminal shows text parts only. Built and tested on Claude Code 2.1.325. Ask the person before setting thinking-weather's town: it sends the town to Open-Meteo.
